profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Vivint Home Security
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: Software Engineer & ML practitioner with a CS PhD from BYU. I specialize in building smart, reliable tech, from healthcare microservices and published research to production Edge AI serving millions of users. I love tackling complex architecture, leading teams, and turning advanced algorithms into simple, delightful products. Always happy to connect!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Scaled Consumer AI: Led production AI features serving millions of active users with sub-second latency and high reliability.
2. Driven Competitive Edge: Optimized model architectures and evaluation pipelines, outperforming key competitor benchmarks in accuracy and speed.
3. Trained Multimodal Models: Built, fine-tuned, and deployed object detectors, Vision Transformers, LLMs, and VLMs tailored for edge and cloud workloads.
4. Led Data Annotation Strategy: Designed Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) annotation pipelines and taxonomy, directly elevating model precision and training efficiency.
positions.insights: Rust (Programming Language), Machine Learning and +7 skills

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
1. Engineering Leadership & Scale: Led a team of engineers managing 50+ Node.js microservices powering a high-priority healthcare app for 500k+ web and mobile users.
2. Cross-Functional Technical Design: Partnered with Enterprise Security, Architecture, Database, and Analytics teams to define technical standards and ensure compliant, secure implementation.
3. Multi-Platform Systems Integration: Orchestrated end-to-end integration across web, mobile, and core enterprise backend systems to guarantee high system availability and performance.
4. Flagship Project Delivery: Spearheaded architectural execution for the company's top-tier digital health initiative under strict enterprise security and data privacy requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Research & Publications: Analyzed patient data and collaborated with academic professors to publish peer-reviewed papers at top-tier international healthcare conferences.
2. Patient Education Platform: Built and maintained a personalized tool delivering vetted, credentialed education materials directly to patients.
3. Clinical Knowledge Management: Curated and managed centralized reference materials for healthcare providers to support evidence-based clinical practices.
